$comment: Review tiers (ADR-057). A change is Tier A (plan + adversarial agent review before code) unless EVERY path it touches is Tier B. Tier B is an allowlist, so an unlisted path fails closed to Tier A (#1604). alwaysTierA wins over every Tier B glob: instruction files, reviewers, hooks, CI, scripts and the checks themselves never go through the light path. tierBNewFilesOnly is Tier B only for a file the session CREATES with Write; editing or overwriting an existing test there is Tier A. notAChange is agent scratch inside the repo dir (plan files, worktrees, hook state): no tier applies. Read by .claude/hooks/review-tier.mjs; pinned by tests/scripts/review-tier.test.ts.
